title: Brett Littman to Lead Museum of Contemporary Art San Diego
summary: The Museum of Contemporary Art San Diego (MCASD) has announced Brett Littman as its new director and CEO. From 2018 to 2023, Littman served as director of the Noguchi Museum in Long Island City, New York.
